summary: Figure 2 contrasts EDM's memory-traffic data path with that of existing Ethernet-based memory disaggregation fabrics. Three columns—Compute Node, Ethernet Switch, and Memory Node—each stack a Processor/Mem Controller, a TCP/IP-or-RDMA protocol box, Ethernet MAC, and Ethernet PHY. A dashed black line traces how existing fabrics route memory traffic up through MAC and the RDMA/TCP stack. A solid red line shows EDM's memory traffic instead entering directly at the Ethernet PHY, bypassing MAC processing, and being handled in the switch by a highlighted Central Scheduler rather than ordinary L2 forwarding. A green line marks non-memory traffic, which still passes through MAC as usual. The figure visually justifies EDM's PHY-layer redesign by showing it shortens the memory path relative to the conventional MAC-layer stack.
summary_zh: 该图对比 EDM 与传统以太网内存分离方案的数据路径：黑色虚线表示传统方案经 MAC 与 RDMA/TCP 栈传输内存流量；红色实线表示 EDM 直接在 PHY 层传输内存流量并由中心调度器处理；绿色表示非内存流量路径。
